projectDescription: A collection of accessible, composable audio UI components for Svelte 5 — copy, paste, and own the code in your project.
keyFeatures: Copy-paste component model — no runtime dependency or lock-in
Composable audio player with play, seek, volume, skip, and rewind controls
AudioProvider for centralized playback lifecycle and state management
Global reactive audioStore built with Svelte 5 runes
Queue management with shuffle, repeat, drag-to-reorder, and insert modes
Track list with store and controlled modes, filtering, and sortable grid layouts
Playback speed control with live stream auto-disable
UI primitives: Fader, Knob, Slider (with buffer), XY Pad, and Sortable List
Automatic localStorage persistence for queue, volume, position, and settings
Live stream detection and graceful degradation of controls
Pre-built Particles (composed component examples) for rapid prototyping
AI-ready documentation with llms.txt and per-page Markdown export
publicApiSurface: audioStore.play / pause / togglePlay / seek / next / previous
htmlAudio.init / load / play / pause / setCurrentTime / setPlaybackRate
htmlAudio.setVolume / setMuted / getVolume / getDuration / getCurrentTime / isLive
